mechanism: Additive CNS depression from lorazepam combined with potential serotonergic effects and sympathomimetic interactions from phenelzine (MAOI), increasing risk of severe sedation, respiratory depression, and hypertensive episodes.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if necessary, use lowest lorazepam doses with careful monitoring of respiratory status, blood pressure, and mental status, with patient counseled on avoiding tyramine-rich foods and other serotonergic agents.
